description: This file defines the EnvironmentStatisticsProvider class, which gathers and provides environment statistics such as CPU and memory usage, utilizing .NET diagnostics and custom filtering. It also includes internal classes for event listening and Kalman filtering used for smoothing metrics.

classes.name: EnvironmentStatisticsProvider
classes.description: Main class providing environment statistics, implementing IDisposable, with internal classes for event listening and Kalman filtering.

classes.name: EventCounterListener
classes.description: Internal class extending EventListener to listen for system runtime events and extract CPU usage metrics.

classes.name: DualModeKalmanFilter
classes.description: Internal class implementing a dual-mode Kalman filter for smoothing CPU and memory metrics.

classes.name: KalmanFilter
classes.description: Internal struct representing a single Kalman filter used within DualModeKalmanFilter.

methods.name: EnvironmentStatisticsProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the environment statistics provider, setting up counters and performing initial GC.

methods.name: GetEnvironmentStatistics
methods.description: Method to retrieve current environment statistics including CPU and memory usage, applying filters.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of resources, particularly the event listener.
